sections.h2: Tamil Nadu, Odisha and Assam promise the full SGST; Rajasthan and Punjab pay 75%

chart.title: Three states reimburse 100% of SGST, two reimburse 75%
chart.sub: Share of net or gross SGST paid back to qualifying investors, %.
chart.source: State industrial policy documents, as stated in this article.

sections.means: Tamil Nadu's 100% applies to only one of four investor-chosen tracks, so the headline rate is not automatic.
sections.todo: Before committing capital, confirm which track applies and whether the SGST base is gross or net.

sections.means: The 5-year windows are MSME tracks in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, so a large unit should not assume them.
sections.todo: Model the payout over the full window, and check whether a cap ends it earlier.

update_notes: Updated 16 November 2026: Himachal Pradesh's 2019 industrial investment policy, which carries the net SGST reimbursement, expired in December 2025 and was extended in stages, the last extension ending on 12 October 2026. As of 5 November 2026 the state had not finalised a new policy, and no further extension had been reported. Source: The Tribune, 5 November 2026.
